fact: A study of crime report handling in Jubek State states that the South Sudan National Police Service uses a paper-based system for handling crime reporting, with crime files misplaced or lost from police shelves; the web application it built is the researcher's proposal, not a system the force deployed. Only the abstract and contents were fetched; the thesis's own year is not on the page (Jubek State existed 2015-2020; Afribary lists it 7 June 2026).
title: Development of Web-Based Application for Crime Report Handling in Police Force A Case of Jubek State, South Sudan National Police Services
